name: swiggy-mcp-server
description: Unified Swiggy MCP - Food delivery, Instamart groceries, and Dineout bookings behind one OAuth token
long_description:
# swiggy-lyr

Aggregates Swiggy's three official remote MCP streams (food, instamart, dineout) into a single local stdio server. Dynamic tool proxying keeps schemas in sync with upstream. Ordering tools are safety-gated: SWIGGY_LYR_ALLOW_ORDERS=1 plus confirm=true for checkout.

## Quick start

1. Install: `install.sh` (or `uv sync`)
2. Auth: `swiggy-lyr --login`
3. Status: `swiggy-lyr --status`
4. Run server: `swiggy-lyr`
tools_note: Tools are proxied dynamically from mcp.swiggy.com/{food,im,dineout}; call tools/list at runtime for the authoritative set.
